body_long:
Vincenzo Finizzola has been appointed General Manager of The Langham, Venice, the hotel Langham Hospitality Group is building on the island of Murano. The group announced the appointment on 4 November 2026. According to La Tribune de l'Hôtellerie, he took up the role in October. The hotel is due to open in 2028.

He reports to Stefan Soennichsen, Regional Vice President, Operations Europe at Langham Hospitality Group. His first task is the pre-opening: recruiting the team, setting up operations and preparing the commercial launch.

## A Renaissance casino and a glass factory

The Langham, Venice brings together the 16th-century Casino Mocenigo and a former glass factory on the Murano waterfront. Matteo Thun & Partners is behind the design, which keeps the Renaissance architecture, the original frescoes and the industrial character of the site, with nods to the island's glassmaking.

The plans count 133 rooms, including 30 suites. Guests will find indoor and alfresco dining, a rooftop bar, a private cooking school and a courtyard garden with a 20-metre swimming pool.

The project has taken time. When Langham broke ground in February 2023, it was aiming for 2026. The date is now 2028.

## Fifty years between London, Milan and Venice

Vincenzo Finizzola began his career at The Savoy in London in 1976. He then worked for CIGA Hotels at the Grand Hotel des Bains and the Excelsior on the Lido, then the Excelsior in Rome. He was General Manager of the Hotel Romazzino on the Costa Smeralda from 1987 to 1990, then of the Gritti Palace in Venice from 1990 to 1992.

In October 1992 he joined Four Seasons to open the Four Seasons Hotel Milano, which welcomed its first guests on 1 April 1993. He led it until July 2015. He went on to TownHouse Hotels and the Seven Stars Galleria in Milan, before returning to Venice as CEO and General Manager of Bauer Palazzo from June 2019 to June 2024. Most recently he was Managing Director of Ca' Sagredo, on the Grand Canal. He has received a Lifetime Achievement Award at the Best Luxury Hotel Awards.

Nils-Arne Schroeder, Chief Operating Officer of Langham Hospitality Group since June 2026, called him "the ideal leader for The Langham, Venice".

## The signal

For a new brand in Venice, the hardest part is not the building but the city: its suppliers, its craftsmen, its boatmen and its loyal guests. By hiring a General Manager with decades of Venetian relationships two years before opening, Langham gives its Venice project local roots from day one. On Murano, away from the Grand Canal, that network will count.

Congratulations to Vincenzo Finizzola on his new role.
summary: Vincenzo Finizzola, former General Manager of the Four Seasons Hotel Milano and the Bauer Palazzo, is the General Manager of The Langham, Venice, a 133-room hotel opening on Murano in 2028.
